basics.name: Md Monirul Islam
basics.label: R&D Engineer & Team Lead — Cybernetics Hi-Tech Solutions
basics.summary: Robotics R&D engineer working at the intersection of motion control, autonomous systems, and embedded hardware. R&D Engineer & Team Lead at [Cybernetics Hi-Tech Solutions](https://cyberneticsbd.com), Dhaka. Designed and field-deployed a production 3-robot AGV fleet in a live garment factory, a ROS 2 / MoveIt 2 manipulator stack with a custom closed-form 7-DOF IK solver, and contributed to the Jontro Soinik EOD ROV family (v1 and v2) now in UN Peacekeeping service. B.Sc. in EEE from BUET (CGPA 3.85/4.00, ranked 25 of 189, awarded with Honours). **Seeking PhD positions for Fall 2027** in robotics, motion control, or autonomous systems.

work.name: Cybernetics Hi-Tech Solutions (Pvt) Ltd
work.summary: End-to-end design, development, and production deployment of robotic platforms across mobile manipulation, multi-robot autonomy, EOD ROVs, drones, and industrial manufacturing.
highlights: Led design and production deployment of a **3-robot AGV fleet** at The Urmi Group (live RMG facility) — ROS 2, custom EKF with AprilTag fiducial fusion, distributed reservation-based path planning, FleetCore coordinator, 3-layer safety architecture. First-ever AGV solution deployed in Bangladesh.

Built a **ROS 2 / MoveIt 2 mobile manipulator control stack** for an 11-joint EOD platform — custom closed-form 7-DOF analytical IK replacing KDL, singularity-aware smooth scaling, FK-anchored accumulator, 5-state FSM, 40-test unit suite. ~3,500 lines of Python including a 2,200-line coordinator node.

Contributed to the **Jontro Soinik EOD ROV family (v1 and v2)** — S-curve arm motion profile (v1), custom multi-drop bus replacing the v1 star topology (v2), differential-drive speed synchronization (v2), BLDC motor synchronization, RS-485 inter-node communication, custom PCB design (Altium / KiCad), 48 V power distribution. v1 deployed in UN Peacekeeping Mission, Mali (2024); v2 set for the Republic of Congo (2025).

Designed **SD15-N autonomous target-tracking surveillance drone** — YOLOv11n on Raspberry Pi 5 + Pixhawk 2.4.8, real-time bounding-box-to-velocity-command pipeline over MAVLink. 1,000 ft altitude, 15 km range, 20 m/s.
Designed **heavy-lift cargo drone** — 50 kg payload, 30 min flight, 15 km comms range, 1.5:1 thrust-to-weight ratio. Custom BMS, propulsion sizing, structural frame analysis.
Designed and manufactured the **CyberMaker Titan550 Pro industrial 3D printer** — CoreXY motion system, 510 × 510 × 550 mm build volume, ±0.02 mm repeatability, Marlin 2.0 firmware.
Delivered the **maiden flight of a VTOL quad-plane prototype** for heavy-lift and long-endurance applications.
Lead engineer mentoring a small team of R&D engineers; ownership of system architecture, hardware selection, software development, field commissioning, and production handover.

publications.name: Differential-Drive Synchronization Using Genetic Algorithm Optimized Cascaded PID Controllers on STM32-Based MCU
publications.title: Differential-Drive Synchronization Using Genetic Algorithm Optimized Cascaded PID Controllers on STM32-Based MCU
publications.summary: Proposed and implemented a Genetic Algorithm-tuned cascaded PID control scheme on an STM32 MCU for precise real-time synchronization of BLDC motors in differential-drive robotic platforms. Outperforms manual and Ziegler-Nichols-tuned baselines under varying loads and battery-voltage disturbances. *Corresponding author; preprint available on request.*

publications.name: A Dual-Network Feedback Communication System for Multi-Node Unmanned Robotic Control
publications.title: A Dual-Network Feedback Communication System for Multi-Node Unmanned Robotic Control
publications.summary: Designed a fault-tolerant dual-network feedback communication architecture providing redundant pathways for coordinating unmanned multi-node robotic systems. *Preprint available on request.*

publications.name: Optimizing Master-Slave Broadcast Communication in Multi-Node Networks Using RS485 Standard
publications.title: Optimizing Master-Slave Broadcast Communication in Multi-Node Networks Using RS485 Standard
publications.summary: Designed and characterized a master-slave broadcast communication architecture using the RS485 standard for real-time coordination of motion control and sensor feedback across multi-DOF unmanned robotic systems.
